cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the law adopted in August 2026 is in force, or that government data is hosted in the national data centres; the 2021 migration order (SEN-001) is older than the window.
cells.note: The National Assembly adopted bill 25/2026 in August 2026 to keep sensitive state data on national territory (SEN-003), and the Prime Minister said cloud services are being set up in the national data centres (SEN-005), so stage 2. No source says the law is in force or that state data is hosted there now, so not 3.
